collection.title: Porsche Panamera 2013 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche Panamera 2013 to 2016 (970) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
